I'm going to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. I know this breaks our agreement. If you also take, the split is random. I'm open to returning cells later if the episode runs long enough for the generator to help.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry, and I know it breaks the agreement. If we get past this storm check, I'll operate with you every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. You can take everything it produces. I won't take any more cells.
